facts.fact: 海伦娜握住辛西娅的手，感觉像伸进冰冷的湖水。
facts.anchor: Taking Cynthia’s hand was like plunging her own into a frigid lake

facts.fact: 电流增强，辛西娅的念头仍对海伦娜隐藏。
facts.anchor: Cynthia’s thoughts remained hidden as the electric current increased

facts.fact: 布莱尔家不向巫团与血亲之外的人透露能力。
facts.anchor: They didn’t reveal their abilities to anyone who wasn’t coven or kin.

facts.fact: 海伦娜认为向人脉极广的辛西娅泄密极其愚蠢。
facts.anchor: To reveal such intimate, potentially deadly secrets

facts.fact: 辛西娅当面否认杀死丈夫休伯特。
facts.anchor: And I did not kill my husband.

facts.fact: 克莱奥掌心腾起蓝色火焰，女巫身份当众暴露。
facts.anchor: a blue flame flickered then flared

facts.fact: 辛西娅抱住克莱奥，承诺不会因秘密失去她。
facts.anchor: You can never lose me, Clio.

facts.fact: 海伦娜意识到说出实情就明天见不到辛西娅。
facts.anchor: Only then, she wouldn’t see Cynthia on the morrow.
